headline: The study
body: Wistar-Kyoto rats. Juvenile and adult groups. | **70 days** of nandrolone versus control. | Lateral head films before and after, digitised and enlarged to 300% for measurement precision.

headline: In juveniles
body: Mandibular **length** rose **27.2%** in treated animals. | Controls rose 24.5%. | Mandibular **height** rose **41.2%** treated against 32.0% control.

headline: In adults
body: the gap is enormous. | Adult controls gained **0.3%** mandibular length. | Adult treated gained **4.7%**. That is 3.6 mm against 0.2 mm.
punch: Controls had basically stopped. Treated adults had not.

headline: Which is the finding
body: Anabolic steroids grew the mandible in animals that had already finished most of their growth. | This is not only a puberty window effect. | Adult craniofacial bone is not inert.
punch: The paper concluded a significant effect in both age groups.

headline: Both dimensions moved
body: not just length. | Horizontal and vertical cephalometric distances both increased more in treated animals. | In both age groups.
punch: The jaw got longer and taller.

headline: The mechanism
body: runs through *IGF-1*. | Juvenile treated and control rats had similar IGF-1 levels. | Adult treated rats had **higher** IGF-1 than adult controls, rising 383% against 255%.
punch: In adults the hormone difference tracked the bone difference.

headline: Why the condyle
body: The *mandibular condyle* is a growth site, not just a joint. | Condylar cartilage growth responds to hormonal and mechanical signals through cAMP and calcium signalling. | It behaves more like a growth plate than like a fixed bone.
punch: Your jaw has an active growth centre in it.

headline: Which is why
body: mechanical load matters here too. | Osteocytes convert strain into chemical signals, lowering **sclerostin** and raising *Wnt*. | Wnt increases bone producing cells and suppresses resorption.
punch: Force and hormones hit the same tissue.

headline: But site dependence
body: is real. | Craniofacial growth is not one process. Mandible, condyle and cranial base have different mechanisms. | A signal that grows one site does not grow them all equally.
punch: Uneven growth across sites changes proportion.

headline: Which is the actual risk
body: not that nothing happens. | Things clearly happen. The question is whether they happen **proportionally**. | Facial harmony depends on the ratio between sites, not the size of one.
punch: Growth is not the same as improvement.

headline: The limits
body: Female Wistar-Kyoto rats on supraphysiologic nandrolone. | Rodent craniofacial growth is not human craniofacial growth. | Direction is clear. Magnitude in a person is not established.
punch: The effect is real. The size is unknown.

headline: It's never over
body: Real mechanisms. Real citations. No protocols.
